scheme_name: Central Sector Scholarship of Top Class Education for SC Students
authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
benefit: Full tuition fee + living allowance ₹3,000/month + books and stationery ₹5,000/year + computer assistance ₹45,000 one-time

criteria.label: Beneficiary Category (Scheduled Caste)
criteria.plain_description: Student must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community.
criteria.source_clause: Top Class SC Scheme Guidelines Clause 3.1
criteria.remediation: Upload valid SC caste certificate issued by competent state authority.

criteria.label: Full-time enrollment in notified degree institution
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must have secured admission in a recognized degree program in an approved technical/professional college.
criteria.source_clause: Top Class SC Scheme Guidelines Clause 3.2

criteria.label: Annual family income ceiling (<= ₹8,00,000 per annum)
criteria.plain_description: Total family annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹8.00 Lakh.
criteria.source_clause: Top Class SC Scheme Guidelines Clause 3.3

criteria.label: Aadhaar verified and bank account ready
criteria.plain_description: Aadhaar must be linked to active bank account for DBT disbursals.

application.office_name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / College Nodal Desk
process_steps: Register via One-Time Registration (OTR) on the National Scholarship Portal
Apply under Department of Social Justice & Empowerment: Top Class Education for SC Students
Upload verified documents and fee break-up structure
Obtain institutional verification via College Nodal Officer
Grant credited directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank account
